speaker: Doctor
text: I understand you have a 3-week history of fatigue, fever, easy bruising, and severe leg pain. To help me identify the cause, please tell me your exact age and if anyone in your family has had a similar illness or bleeding problems recently.

speaker: Patient
text: 4-year-old girl. The patient has been experiencing generalized fatigue and easy bruising for 3 weeks. Over the past week, she has developed a fever and severe leg pain that wakes her up at night.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for the details; the night-time leg pain and bruising in a 4-year-old are very concerning. Can you describe the appearance of the bruises and whether she has noticed any swelling, lumps, or petechiae (tiny red spots) on her skin?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Generalized fatigue and easy bruising. I also have Fever, Severe leg pain that disturbs sleep.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Acute Leukemia.

The combination of fever, bone pain, fatigue, and bruising in a 4-year-old is highly suggestive of leukemia. I need to confirm this with immediate labs.
REQUEST TEST: Complete_Blood_Count_with_Differential and Platelets, Coagulation_Protile.
REQUEST IMAGES: Peripheral_Blood_Smear.
